1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi, babwirisha inanga ijwi ryo mu gituza. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

2.text: Uwiteka tabara kuko umunyarukundo ashira,Abanyamurava babura mu bantu.

3.text: Bose barabeshyana,Bavugisha iminwa ishyeshya n'imitima ibiri.

4.text: Uwiteka azatsemba iminwa yose ishyeshya,N'ururimi rwirarira,

5.text: Abavuze bati “Tuzaneshesha indimi zacu,Iminwa yacu ni iyacu udutwara ni nde?”

6.text: “Ku bwo kunyagwa k'umunyamubabaro,Ku bwo gusuhuza umutima k'umukene,Nonaha ndahaguruka”, ni ko Uwiteka avuga,“Ndashyira mu mahoro uwo bacurira ingoni.”

7.text: Amagambo y'Uwiteka ni amagambo atanduye,Ahwanye n'ifeza igeragejwe mu ruganda rwo mu isi,Ivugutiwe karindwi.

8.text: Uwiteka uzabarinda,Uzabakiza ab'iki gihe iteka ryose.

9.text: Abanyabyaha bagenda hose impande zose,Iyo abatagira umumaro bashyizwe hejuru mu bantu.
